content.text:
The company proposes contract_research with company_owns. My hard limit allows contract_research, so that's fine. But I want university ownership of results. Let me change ip to uni_owns_option_to_licence and extend publication review to 30 days (down from 60). I can trade on publication reviewDays (give them 60) to get ip ownership.

Actually I should change at most two fields. I'll change ip and publication reviewDays (from 60 to 30).
